title: All Distinct Permutations of a String
statement: Given a string S (possibly with duplicate characters), generate all distinct permutations and print them in lexicographic order, one per line.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 7
S contains only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: All distinct permutations of S in lexicographic order, one per line.

examples.output:
abc
acb
bac
bca
cab
cba
examples.explanation: All 6 permutations of 'abc' in sorted order.

s = input().strip()
# Write your solution here
# Hint: sort s, backtrack with a used[] flag; skip duplicates
